title: Pocket Money
text:
Lucy is ten years old. Every Saturday, her parents give her five euros of pocket money. She likes to save some of it in a small box. She spends the rest at the shop on the corner.

Last month, Lucy saved twenty euros. She wanted to buy a new book about animals. On Saturday, she went to the bookshop with her brother Tom. Tom bought a toy car with his money.

questions.text: How much pocket money does Lucy get every Saturday?
What did Lucy want to buy?
Why does Lucy save some of her money?
options: She wants to buy something bigger later

questions.text: What kind of person is Lucy most likely?

vocabulary.definition: money a child receives to spend on small things

paragraph_translations: Lucy tiene diez años. Cada sábado, sus padres le dan cinco euros de dinero de bolsillo. Le gusta ahorrar algo de ese dinero en una caja pequeña. Gasta el resto en la tienda de la esquina.
El mes pasado, Lucy ahorró veinte euros. Quería comprar un libro nuevo sobre animales. El sábado, fue a la librería con su hermano Tom. Tom compró un coche de juguete con su dinero.
